key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX)
AUD/USD weakened sharply on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase pressuring materials sector
Oil prices surged on Saudi pipeline drone attack and US-Iran war fears, lifting fuel costs by ~30c/L
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
ANZ (ANZ.AX) post-3,500 job cuts faces long strategic turnaround
Queensland credit rating downgrade raises sovereign risk for Qld-linked assets
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices falling sharply, affordable segment resilient; first-home buyer surge
Mining cap-raise wave (Canaccord-led) signals capital stress in junior miners

sectors.trend: Bearish. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners led the $90bn sell-off. Junior miners scrambling for cap raises via Canaccord. Gold under pressure ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Juniors (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Aruma) at elevated dilution risk. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX post-restructuring still faces execution risk. Qld credit downgrade adds sovereign overlay.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening. Net interest margin tailwind offset by credit-risk repricing in Qld.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil surge benefits Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) upstream. Australia softening gas supply rules eases Asian LNG fears. Fuel cost pass-through pressures downstream.
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX see revenue upside but margin squeeze at retail. Diesel spike hits agribusiness (SUG.AX, TNL.AX).

sectors.trend: Weak. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached its own price freeze; women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals demand softness. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Discretionary names under pressure. Defensive rotation into staples likely.

sectors.trend: Resilient. CSL (CSL.AX) and Kiniksa-type names offer relative safety. AI/cloud names (HIVE/BUZZ HPC, MongoDB, GitLab) show strong revenue growth but cash-flow concerns.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX defensive bid. Tech small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) volatile; AI theme intact but selective.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end residential prices falling steeply; affordable segment resilient. RBA rental inflation concern supports REIT occupancy but pressures affordability.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) benefit from rental demand. Residential developers (DHG.AX, LVH.AX) face high-end softness. First-home buyer surge supports entry-level.

key_themes: Oil shock: Saudi pipeline attack + US-Iran tensions driving crude higher, lifting AUD inflation risk
Rate-path uncertainty: RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare; bond yields rising
Iron ore correction: China demand weakness triggering 'bloodletting' in pricing
AUD weakness: Growth scare and oil import bill pressuring currency
Mining capital stress: Wave of cap raises signals liquidity crunch in juniors
Housing bifurcation: High-end correction vs affordable resilience; policy debate intensifying
Superannuation reform debate: Populist pressure vs institutional stability
Energy security: Australia easing gas export rules to stabilise Asian LNG markets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / geopolitical escalation (US-Iran, Saudi pipeline)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour upstream (STO.AX, WDS.AX) over downstream; monitor Brent $/bbl above $95

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into premature rate hike on rental/inflation data
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and property developers; favour fixed-income ladders

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse hitting BHP/RIO/FMG earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight pure-play iron ore; diversify into copper/gold (BHP.AX copper tilt, GOLD.AX)
Avoid pre-announcement juniors; favour cash-flow-positive producers over explorers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit downgrade / sovereign risk spillover
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review Qld-exposed REITs and infrastructure; monitor Qld bond spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and consumer squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy retailers

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream energy on oil shock
opportunities.rationale: Crude surge from geopolitical risk supports STO.AX and WDS.AX revenue; Australia easing gas rules adds policy tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt into healthcare and quality staples
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and SGH.AX offer earnings visibility amid macro volatility; superannuation debate supports long-term healthcare demand

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exposure on safe-haven bid
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk and AUD weakness support gold miners despite near-term 'schmould'; Kuniko and Gateway WA exploration upside

opportunities.recommendation: Entry-level residential developers on first-home buyer surge
opportunities.rationale: Housing bifurcation: affordable segment resilient; policy support for first-home buyers

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; BHP.AX and RIO.AX earnings at risk from China demand weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern raises rate-hike probability; high-end prices already correcting
Canaccord-led capital raise wave signals dilution risk; limited liquidity in small-caps

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with commodity-linked or export-revenue assets
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import-cost inflation risk rising

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil shock, rate fears, and iron ore weakness persist. AUD weakness adds import-inflation pressure. Expect 3–5% further downside in ^AXJO before stabilisation. Miners and banks remain the laggards.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Energy security policy shifts, housing affordability reforms, and superannuation system evolution create structural opportunities. Iron ore correction may create entry points for quality producers by Q1 2027. Healthcare and infrastructure remain structural growth themes.
